_Jwt: SigningKeyPem is deliberately absent — it is a secret and startup fails without it. Supply it for local runs with `dotnet user-secrets set Jwt:SigningKeyPem "$(openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048)"` or the Jwt__SigningKeyPem env var. Issuer/Audience are not secrets, but startup fails without them too, so dev values live here.
_Stripe: ApiKey and WebhookSecret are deliberately absent — they are secrets, and startup fails without them now that stripe is the only payment provider. Supply them for local runs with `dotnet user-secrets set Stripe:ApiKey sk_test_...` and `dotnet user-secrets set Stripe:WebhookSecret whsec_...`, or the Stripe__ApiKey / Stripe__WebhookSecret env vars. The test host supplies its own in Store.Tests/Endpoints/StoreApiFactory.cs.
